en: One milliliter of liquid water expands into about 1,700 milliliters of steam when boiled.
A block of osmium the size of a standard brick weighs over 25 kilograms.
The Earth's oceans contain about 3.5 percent dissolved salt by total weight.
Iron nails gain weight when they rust because they chemically combine with oxygen from the air.
Nitrogen gas makes up exactly 78 percent of the air you breathe, while oxygen makes up 21 percent.
Water expands by about nine percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
A single drop of water contains approximately 1.5 sextillion individual water molecules.
Solid dry ice sublimates directly into carbon dioxide gas at negative 78.5 degrees Celsius.
Human blood is a mixture containing about 55 percent liquid plasma and 45 percent solid cells.
The metal tungsten has the highest melting point of all elements at 3,422 degrees Celsius.
Mercury is a metallic element that remains completely liquid at a standard room temperature of 25 degrees Celsius.
Cow's milk is a liquid mixture containing about 87 percent water and 4 percent fat globules.
